title: Contrablend
author: Cary Ravitz
notes: The Caller's Box 219, permission: full. The dance M6's per-role progression exists for: the larks progress one place and the robins three, so the shadow the second roll-away leaves you beside is your new partner. `progression` and the second roll-away's `rebind` are what say so.

source.transcript:
A1  (4) Neighbor balance  (12) Neighbor swing
A2  (6) Circle left 3/4  (10) Partner swing
B1  (8) In long lines, go forward and back while partner roll away (W roll L, M side-step R)  (8) In long lines, go forward and back while shadow roll away (W roll L, M side-step R) (new partner)
B2  (6) Circle right 3/4 [with shadow]; turn alone  (10) N2 neighbor right shoulder round 1 & 1/2; face N3

figures.call: LONG LINES FORWARD AND BACK, ROLL AWAY YOUR PARTNER
AGAIN, ROLL AWAY YOUR SHADOW; NEW PARTNER
CIRCLE RIGHT THREE QUARTERS WITH YOUR SHADOW
RIGHT SHOULDER ROUND NUMBER TWO, ONCE AND A HALF
